featured.title: FBI blames North Korea for stolen billions from Binance in biggest hack in history
featured.summary: The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest cryptocurrency heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI said on Saturday. The Federal Bureau of Investigation said in a statement that this week’s attack was tied to “malicious cyber activity” by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a US$1.5 billion Bybit hack last year. The FBI asked cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain analytics companies and others to block...
featured.titleZh: FBI指控朝鲜策划了史上最大规模的币安加密货币盗窃案
featured.summaryZh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）表示，币安近期发生的数十亿美元被盗事件是史上最大规模的加密货币劫案，系朝鲜黑客所为。该攻击与名为“TraderTraitor”的黑客组织有关，该组织此前也曾参与去年针对Bybit的15亿美元黑客攻击。
featured.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了加密货币交易所面临的严峻安全威胁以及朝鲜利用网络犯罪规避制裁的持续风险。

featured.titleZh: G20外长亚特兰大会议结束，未就关键议题达成共识
featured.summaryZh: G20外长会议在亚特兰大闭幕，美国国务卿卢比奥呼吁成员国加强供应链安全并保障战略贸易路线。尽管各方承认关键矿产和航行自由的重要性，但会议未能就具体行动达成一致。
featured.whyImportant: 会议结果显示全球主要经济体在供应链重组和地缘政治议题上仍存在显著分歧。

featured.titleZh: 香港电讯称美国监管令已“终止”，据报将退出美国市场
featured.summaryZh: 香港电讯确认，美国联邦通信委员会此前要求其说明运营合理性的命令已终止。据报道，该公司已同意在美方国家安全担忧的压力下逐步退出美国市场。
featured.whyImportant: 此举反映了地缘政治因素对跨国电信企业在美运营环境的持续影响。

featured.title: 3 Hong Kong Chinese-language newspapers raise retail prices by HK$3
featured.summary: Three Chinese-language newspapers in Hong Kong have raised their retail prices by HK$3 (40 US cents) this month, marking the first sector-wide adjustment in two years. Ming Pao’s price rise took effect on Sunday, increasing its single-copy price from HK$12 to HK$15, up 25 per cent. Two financial broadsheets will follow suit on Monday. The Hong Kong Economic Times (HKET) will raise its price from HK$12 to HK$15, while the Hong Kong Economic Journal (HKEJ) will increase its price by 20 per cent...
featured.titleZh: 香港三家中文报纸零售价上调3港元
featured.summaryZh: 香港三家中文报纸本月起将零售价上调3港元，这是该行业两年来首次集体调价。明报、香港经济日报及香港经济日报旗下的财经报刊均在调整之列。
featured.whyImportant: 报业集体涨价反映了传统媒体在运营成本上升压力下的生存挑战。

featured.titleZh: 香港财政司司长：经济增长或创五年新高，可能上调GDP预测
featured.summaryZh: 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，得益于上半年5.1%的增长及出口表现，香港今年经济增长有望创五年新高。政府正考虑上调此前3.5%至4.5%的年度增长预测。
featured.whyImportant: 经济增长预期上调显示香港经济在外部环境挑战下展现出较强的韧性。

featured.summaryZh: 孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼访问日本，标志着该国在摆脱威权统治后寻求经济机遇与外交自主。孟加拉国政府正致力于通过务实的外交政策，利用与日本及中国的合作来改善民生。

global.summaryZh: 美国和伊朗的外交部长均表示，通过外交途径结束战争仍有可能性。双方正就此进行相关沟通与探讨。

global.summary: A Chinese photographer is facing fierce public backlash for charging middle-aged women inflated fees while allegedly subjecting them to sexually suggestive remarks during photo shoots. Known online as “Duan Gongzi,” 48-year-old army veteran Duan Xiaozhou has amassed nearly 400,000 followers on Douyin. At his Wuhan studio, he charges 16,800 yuan (US$2,500) for 36 unedited portraits. Duan promotes his sessions as empathetic exchanges intended to capture clients’ authentic selves. But...
global.titleZh: 中国摄影师向“孤独”中年女性收取高额费用拍摄“调情”照片引发争议
global.summaryZh: 一名被称为“段公子”的摄影师因向中年女性收取高额拍摄费，并在拍摄过程中发表性暗示言论而遭到公众强烈抵制。尽管他声称拍摄旨在捕捉客户的真实自我，但其行为引发了关于职业道德和剥削心理脆弱群体的广泛讨论。
global.whyImportant: 该事件反映了社会对针对特定群体进行商业剥削行为的敏感度提升，以及对网络营销伦理的关注。

global.title: Russia surpasses France in African youth appeal, still trails China: survey
global.summary: Russia’s influence has surged among young people across Africa in recent years, leaping over former colonial power France while still trailing China, a survey of African youths has found. Many young Africans now perceive Russia to be an ally, observers said, warning its rivals to take the shift seriously as the continent becomes increasingly critical to both Moscow and Beijing. global.titleZh: 调查显示：俄罗斯在非洲青年中的影响力已超过法国，但仍落后于中国
global.summaryZh: 一项针对非洲青年的调查发现，俄罗斯在非洲的影响力近年来显著上升，已超过前殖民宗主国法国，但仍排在中国之后。许多非洲年轻人将俄罗斯视为盟友，观察人士警告称，随着非洲战略地位的提升，各国应重视这一地缘政治格局的变化。
global.whyImportant: 这一趋势表明非洲在国际地缘政治竞争中的重要性日益凸显，大国在该地区的影响力博弈正在加剧。

global.title: Singapore turns up heat on power-hungry air conditioning with cool revolution
global.summary: Long dubbed an “air-conditioned nation”, Singapore is experimenting with cooling alternatives from chilled beams to “passive displacement” to curb its thirst for energy-guzzling air conditioning. The city state has the highest per-capita air conditioner ownership rate in Southeast Asia, with about 99 per cent of private residences equipped with cooling units. global.titleZh: 新加坡掀起“降温革命”，应对高能耗空调使用问题
global.summaryZh: 作为东南亚空调普及率最高的国家，新加坡正尝试通过冷梁和被动置换通风等替代技术来减少对空调的依赖。建筑业占该国排放量的五分之一，其中空调能耗占比极高，政府正寻求更可持续的降温方案。
global.whyImportant: 新加坡的尝试为热带城市在应对气候变化和高能耗需求之间寻找平衡提供了参考范例。

global.summary: Former Japanese adult film actress Mao Hamasaki was admitted to intensive care at a Hong Kong hospital after being allegedly drugged while working in a club in Tsim Sha Tsui on Sunday morning. global.titleZh: 日本前成人电影女星在香港疑遭下药，目前处于重症监护中
global.summaryZh: 日本前成人电影女星滨崎真绪在香港尖沙咀一家俱乐部工作时，疑似遭人下药，随后被送往医院重症监护室。其经纪人在社交媒体上发布了她被送往医院的照片，并确认了相关情况。
global.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对海外工作者安全保障以及香港夜生活场所治安问题的关注。

global.summary: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport has reclaimed its position as China’s busiest airport, handling more than 67 million passenger trips in the first nine months of 2026 following a major expansion last year, the municipal government announced. The airport overtook Shanghai Pudong International Airport, which handled 66.58 million passenger trips during the same period, official data showed. Baiyun had fallen behind Pudong in 2024 and 2025. global.titleZh: 广州白云机场完成80亿美元扩建，重夺中国最繁忙机场称号

global.whyImportant: 这一数据变化凸显了广州作为区域航空枢纽的竞争力提升及中国民航市场的复苏。

usa.titleZh: 伊朗最高领袖警告美国和以色列不要发动战争

usa.title: UK police should not have let US force take over airbase trial, MoD documents show
usa.summary: According to documents obtained by the Guardian, officials accused Cambridgeshire force of breaching US-UK deal by handing over case of woman strangled by US pilot Ministry of Defence officials have privately accused a UK police force of wrongly handing over the investigation of an American fighter pilot who strangled a British woman to the US military, according to documents obtained by the Guardian. Cambridgeshire police allowed the US military police to quickly take control of the investigation into Capt Jacob Wulfson after he had been accused of sexually assaulting Sarah Steele in his Cambridge flat. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 英国国防部文件显示：警方不应允许美军接管空军基地案件调查
usa.summaryZh: 据《卫报》获取的文件显示，英国国防部官员私下指责剑桥郡警方违规，将一名美军飞行员涉嫌勒死英国女性的案件移交给美军处理。警方在接到指控后，迅速允许美军宪兵接管了对雅各布·沃尔夫森上尉的调查。
usa.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于司法管辖权及美英军事协议执行情况的争议，受到公众广泛关注。

usa.title: With ‘Kissinger moment’ over, US and China urged to foster new ‘bridge builders’
usa.summary: Beijing and Washington have been urged to foster a new generation of talent to bridge gaps between the countries and strengthen people-to-people exchanges amid growing frictions and concerns about a lack of China expertise in the US. Academics and experts from the two countries gathered in Shanghai on Friday at the China-US Intergenerational Dialogue 2026. They were seeking a new crop of “bridge builders” like Henry Kissinger, the former US secretary of state who helped to engineer the historic...
usa.titleZh: 随着“基辛格时刻”结束，美中被敦促培养新一代“桥梁建设者”
usa.summaryZh: 面对双边摩擦加剧及美国国内中国专业人才匮乏的担忧，北京和华盛顿被敦促培养新一代人才以加强民间交流。在上海举行的中美代际对话会议上，专家们呼吁寻找像基辛格那样能够弥合两国分歧的“桥梁建设者”。
usa.whyImportant: 在当前地缘政治紧张背景下，加强两国人才交流被视为缓解对抗、促进长期稳定的关键。

usa.title: Starmer says UK must get closer to Europe as US relationship changes
usa.summary: Shift in dealings with Washington not likely to reset once Trump leaves Oval Office, former PM says The UK and other European nations must draw closer together as the US becomes a less-reliable partner, Keir Starmer has said in his first significant political intervention since leaving No 10. The former prime minister warned European leaders of the threat posed by Russia, among others, and said the shift in relations with Washington during Donald Trump’s presidency was not likely to reset once he leaves the Oval Office. He accused them of being caught out by these new realities twice already. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 斯塔默称随着美英关系变化，英国必须与欧洲走得更近
usa.summaryZh: 英国前首相斯塔默表示，随着美国日益成为不可靠的伙伴，英国及其他欧洲国家必须加强团结。他警告称，特朗普执政期间美英关系发生的转变即便在特朗普离任后也难以恢复原状。
usa.whyImportant: 这一表态反映了欧洲政界对美国外交政策不确定性的深层忧虑，可能影响未来英国的战略重心。

usa.title: More than 50m Americans cast ballots in early voting with three days to go before midterms
usa.summary: Record number of early votes cast, with Democrats outnumbering Republicans in states which collect that information There has been a surge of early voting for the US midterm elections, with millions more Americans going to the polls compared with the last such election amid a series of tight contests that will determine control of Congress. More than 50.5m early votes have been cast across the US as of Saturday morning, according to an analysis by the University of Florida. This is already nearly 5m more votes than the total number of early votes made in the last midterm elections, in 2022. Continue reading...
usa.titleZh: 美国中期选举临近，提前投票人数已超5000万
usa.summaryZh: 美国中期选举投票进入最后三天，提前投票人数创下历史新高。据佛罗里达大学分析，目前已有超过5050万张选票投出，比2022年中期选举的总提前投票数多出近500万。
usa.whyImportant: 高投票率反映了选民对国会控制权争夺的高度关注，可能对选举最终结果产生重大影响。

watch.title: Far from home, close to grief: why millions of Filipino migrants dread Undas
watch.summary: For over three decades, Dolores Balladares Pelaez has lived and worked in Hong Kong without once returning to the Philippines for Undas, the annual two-day observance honouring the dead. This year, she is arranging prayers from afar for her late father and four siblings, but will once again miss the gathering back home. On Thursday morning, the 56-year-old domestic helper called her mother and niece in Laguna province to discuss hiring a prayer leader to visit the family home. Her sisters-in-law...
watch.titleZh: 远离家乡，心系哀思：为何数百万菲律宾移民惧怕“亡人节”
watch.summaryZh: 对于在香港工作的菲律宾家政工多洛雷斯·巴拉达雷斯·佩拉埃斯而言，由于长期无法回国，每年的“亡人节”都充满了对已故亲人的思念。她只能通过远程安排祈祷仪式，以表达对家乡亲人的哀思。
watch.whyImportant: 该报道揭示了海外劳工群体在传统节日期间面临的心理压力与情感困境。

watch.title: India’s largest dam planned to counter China faces Indigenous revolt
watch.summary: Indigenous people of Arunachal Pradesh are protesting a mega dam planned to counter China's upstream hydropower project.
watch.titleZh: 印度计划修建最大水坝以抗衡中国，引发原住民抗议
watch.summaryZh: 印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦的原住民正在抗议一项大型水坝建设计划。该项目旨在抗衡中国在上游地区推进的水电工程。
watch.whyImportant: 该项目涉及跨境水资源开发与当地原住民权益的冲突，是中印地缘政治竞争在边境地区的具体体现。

watch.title: Quad not ‘anti-China’, says Rubio as first summit in two years set before Trump-Xi talks
watch.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, or the Quad, was not an “anti-China” coalition, as the grouping’s top diplomats finalised preparations for the leaders’ summit in the Philippines next month. Rubio’s statement comes just weeks before US President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China. “It is not an anti-China or anti-anybody coalition,” Rubio said at a press conference on the sidelines of the...
watch.titleZh: 卢比奥称“四方安全对话”并非“反华”联盟，峰会将在特朗普与习近平会晤前举行
watch.summaryZh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，“四方安全对话”（Quad）并非针对中国的联盟。该组织正为下个月在菲律宾举行的领导人峰会做准备，而此前美国总统特朗普计划在深圳与中国领导人习近平会晤。
watch.whyImportant: 此表态旨在缓和地区紧张局势，为即将到来的高层会晤营造外交氛围。

items.title: FBI blames North Korea for stolen billions from Binance in biggest hack in history
items.summary: The theft of billions of dollars from Binance within a matter of minutes, the biggest cryptocurrency heist in history, was orchestrated by North Korean hackers, the FBI said on Saturday. The Federal Bureau of Investigation said in a statement that this week’s attack was tied to “malicious cyber activity” by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a US$1.5 billion Bybit hack last year. The FBI asked cryptocurrency exchanges, blockchain analytics companies and others to block...
items.titleZh: FBI指控朝鲜策划了史上最大规模的币安加密货币盗窃案
items.summaryZh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）表示，币安近期发生的数十亿美元被盗事件是史上最大规模的加密货币劫案，系朝鲜黑客所为。该攻击与名为“TraderTraitor”的黑客组织有关，该组织此前也曾参与去年针对Bybit的15亿美元黑客攻击。
items.whyImportant: 此事件凸显了加密货币交易所面临的严峻安全威胁以及朝鲜利用网络犯罪规避制裁的持续风险。

items.title: G20 foreign ministers end Atlanta meeting without consensus on key issues
items.summary: As Washington seeks to loosen China’s dominance over critical minerals, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio urged other members of the Group of 20 (G20) to strengthen supply chains and secure strategic trade routes as the group’s foreign ministers’ meeting drew to a close in Atlanta on Saturday. Rubio said there was a “universal recognition” among the G20 members over the importance of issues like critical minerals, supply chain security and freedom of navigation. “The first step is at least some...
items.titleZh: G20外长亚特兰大会议结束，未就关键议题达成共识
items.summaryZh: G20外长会议在亚特兰大闭幕，美国国务卿卢比奥呼吁成员国加强供应链安全并保障战略贸易路线。尽管各方承认关键矿产和航行自由的重要性，但会议未能就具体行动达成一致。
items.whyImportant: 会议结果显示全球主要经济体在供应链重组和地缘政治议题上仍存在显著分歧。

items.title: HKT says US order ‘ceased’ as firm reportedly agrees to exit American market
items.summary: A leading Hong Kong telecommunications carrier has confirmed that an order requiring it to justify its operation in the United States has been ceased, after the company reportedly agreed to wind down its business under pressure from a US regulatory agency over national security concerns. A spokeswoman for Hong Kong Telecom (HKT) told the South China Morning Post on Saturday that the Order to Show Cause issued by the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) in October requiring it to justify...
items.titleZh: 香港电讯称美国监管令已“终止”，据报将退出美国市场
items.summaryZh: 香港电讯确认，美国联邦通信委员会此前要求其说明运营合理性的命令已终止。据报道，该公司已同意在美方国家安全担忧的压力下逐步退出美国市场。
items.whyImportant: 此举反映了地缘政治因素对跨国电信企业在美运营环境的持续影响。

items.title: 3 Hong Kong Chinese-language newspapers raise retail prices by HK$3
items.summary: Three Chinese-language newspapers in Hong Kong have raised their retail prices by HK$3 (40 US cents) this month, marking the first sector-wide adjustment in two years. Ming Pao’s price rise took effect on Sunday, increasing its single-copy price from HK$12 to HK$15, up 25 per cent. Two financial broadsheets will follow suit on Monday. The Hong Kong Economic Times (HKET) will raise its price from HK$12 to HK$15, while the Hong Kong Economic Journal (HKEJ) will increase its price by 20 per cent...
items.titleZh: 香港三家中文报纸零售价上调3港元
items.summaryZh: 香港三家中文报纸本月起将零售价上调3港元，这是该行业两年来首次集体调价。明报、香港经济日报及香港经济日报旗下的财经报刊均在调整之列。
items.whyImportant: 报业集体涨价反映了传统媒体在运营成本上升压力下的生存挑战。

items.title: FBI says North Korea behind $6 billion Binance crypto theft
items.summary: The FBI said the theft was tied to "malicious cyber activity" by an entity known as TraderTraitor, the same actors behind a $1.5 billion Bybit hack last year.
items.titleZh: FBI称朝鲜是币安60亿美元加密货币被盗案的幕后黑手
items.summaryZh: FBI指出，此次盗窃案与名为“TraderTraitor”的实体进行的恶意网络活动有关。该组织此前曾策划了去年针对Bybit的15亿美元黑客攻击。
items.whyImportant: 该指控进一步证实了国际执法机构对朝鲜网络攻击能力的关注及其对全球金融系统的破坏性影响。

items.title: Hong Kong may raise GDP forecast as growth could hit 5-year high: Paul Chan
items.summary: Hong Kong’s annual economic growth may hit a five-year high, the finance chief has said, raising the possibility of an upward revision to the current forecast of 3.5 to 4.5 per cent for 2026. Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said on Saturday that coming third-quarter figures indicated sustained momentum, noting the economy grew by 5.1 per cent in the first half of 2026 over a year earlier. “Although the third-quarter figures have not yet been released, I can share that exports remained very...
items.titleZh: 香港财政司司长：经济增长或创五年新高，可能上调GDP预测
items.summaryZh: 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，得益于上半年5.1%的增长及出口表现，香港今年经济增长有望创五年新高。政府正考虑上调此前3.5%至4.5%的年度增长预测。
items.whyImportant: 经济增长预期上调显示香港经济在外部环境挑战下展现出较强的韧性。

items.title: Both Japan and China can help Bangladesh reach its full potential
items.summary: In the Land of the Rising Sun, Bangladesh looks forward to a new dawn. The hope that comes with Prime Minister Tarique Rahman’s visit to Japan goes beyond the deals signed or the financial support expected. It shows a country that has emerged from authoritarian rule and wants to turn its new political voice into bigger economic chances and freedom of choice. For a government chosen by the people, foreign policy must answer one question: how does it make life better for the people who gave it...
items.titleZh: 日本和中国均可助力孟加拉国充分发挥其潜力
items.summaryZh: 孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼访问日本，标志着该国在摆脱威权统治后寻求经济机遇与外交自主。孟加拉国政府正致力于通过务实的外交政策，利用与日本及中国的合作来改善民生。
items.whyImportant: 这体现了孟加拉国在后威权时代通过平衡大国关系以寻求经济发展和国家利益最大化的战略考量。

items.title: What we know about latest efforts to end US war on Iran
items.summary: The foreign ministers of the US and Iran say a diplomatic end to the war is still possible.
items.titleZh: 关于结束美国对伊朗战争的最新努力有哪些进展
items.summaryZh: 美国和伊朗的外交部长均表示，通过外交途径结束战争仍有可能性。双方正就此进行相关沟通与探讨。
items.whyImportant: 这表明尽管局势紧张，但双方仍保留了通过外交手段解决冲突的意愿，对地区稳定具有重要意义。

items.title: ‘Flirtatious’ US$2,500 photo shoots for ‘lonely’ middle-aged women spark backlash in China
items.summary: A Chinese photographer is facing fierce public backlash for charging middle-aged women inflated fees while allegedly subjecting them to sexually suggestive remarks during photo shoots. Known online as “Duan Gongzi,” 48-year-old army veteran Duan Xiaozhou has amassed nearly 400,000 followers on Douyin. At his Wuhan studio, he charges 16,800 yuan (US$2,500) for 36 unedited portraits. Duan promotes his sessions as empathetic exchanges intended to capture clients’ authentic selves. But...
items.titleZh: 中国摄影师向“孤独”中年女性收取高额费用拍摄“调情”照片引发争议
items.summaryZh: 一名被称为“段公子”的摄影师因向中年女性收取高额拍摄费，并在拍摄过程中发表性暗示言论而遭到公众强烈抵制。尽管他声称拍摄旨在捕捉客户的真实自我，但其行为引发了关于职业道德和剥削心理脆弱群体的广泛讨论。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了社会对针对特定群体进行商业剥削行为的敏感度提升，以及对网络营销伦理的关注。

items.title: Russia surpasses France in African youth appeal, still trails China: survey
items.summary: Russia’s influence has surged among young people across Africa in recent years, leaping over former colonial power France while still trailing China, a survey of African youths has found. Many young Africans now perceive Russia to be an ally, observers said, warning its rivals to take the shift seriously as the continent becomes increasingly critical to both Moscow and Beijing. According to the African Youth Survey commissioned by the South Africa-based Ichikowitz Family Foundation, 54 per cent...
items.titleZh: 调查显示：俄罗斯在非洲青年中的影响力已超过法国，但仍落后于中国
items.summaryZh: 一项针对非洲青年的调查发现，俄罗斯在非洲的影响力近年来显著上升，已超过前殖民宗主国法国，但仍排在中国之后。许多非洲年轻人将俄罗斯视为盟友，观察人士警告称，随着非洲战略地位的提升，各国应重视这一地缘政治格局的变化。
items.whyImportant: 这一趋势表明非洲在国际地缘政治竞争中的重要性日益凸显，大国在该地区的影响力博弈正在加剧。

items.title: Singapore turns up heat on power-hungry air conditioning with cool revolution
items.summary: Long dubbed an “air-conditioned nation”, Singapore is experimenting with cooling alternatives from chilled beams to “passive displacement” to curb its thirst for energy-guzzling air conditioning. The city state has the highest per-capita air conditioner ownership rate in Southeast Asia, with about 99 per cent of private residences equipped with cooling units. Singapore’s local building sector accounts for one-fifth of its emissions, while cooling itself accounts for 40 to 60 per cent of a...
items.titleZh: 新加坡掀起“降温革命”，应对高能耗空调使用问题
items.summaryZh: 作为东南亚空调普及率最高的国家，新加坡正尝试通过冷梁和被动置换通风等替代技术来减少对空调的依赖。建筑业占该国排放量的五分之一，其中空调能耗占比极高，政府正寻求更可持续的降温方案。
items.whyImportant: 新加坡的尝试为热带城市在应对气候变化和高能耗需求之间寻找平衡提供了参考范例。

items.title: Ex-Japanese adult film actress in intensive care after alleged drugging in Hong Kong
items.summary: Former Japanese adult film actress Mao Hamasaki was admitted to intensive care at a Hong Kong hospital after being allegedly drugged while working in a club in Tsim Sha Tsui on Sunday morning. Hamasaki’s manager published a post on her Facebook page at 5.40am on Sunday morning, with two photos showing her in a wheelchair being taken to an ambulance. The post read “drugged while working”. Hamasaki had performed as a disc jockey at several clubs on Halloween night until the early hours of Sunday,...
items.titleZh: 日本前成人电影女星在香港疑遭下药，目前处于重症监护中
items.summaryZh: 日本前成人电影女星滨崎真绪在香港尖沙咀一家俱乐部工作时，疑似遭人下药，随后被送往医院重症监护室。其经纪人在社交媒体上发布了她被送往医院的照片，并确认了相关情况。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对海外工作者安全保障以及香港夜生活场所治安问题的关注。

items.title: France protests enter third week as police fire tear gas
items.summary: Police used tear gas to disperse protesters as demonstrations entered a third week ahead in France.
items.titleZh: 法国抗议活动进入第三周，警方发射催泪瓦斯
items.summaryZh: 法国的抗议示威活动已进入第三周。警方在现场使用催泪瓦斯驱散抗议人群。
items.whyImportant: 此次持续的社会动荡反映了法国国内深层的政治与社会矛盾。

items.title: Guangzhou reclaims crown as China’s busiest airport after US$8 billion mega expansion
items.summary: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport has reclaimed its position as China’s busiest airport, handling more than 67 million passenger trips in the first nine months of 2026 following a major expansion last year, the municipal government announced. The airport overtook Shanghai Pudong International Airport, which handled 66.58 million passenger trips during the same period, official data showed. Baiyun had fallen behind Pudong in 2024 and 2025. The expansion took half a decade to complete and...
items.titleZh: 广州白云机场完成80亿美元扩建，重夺中国最繁忙机场称号
items.summaryZh: 广州白云国际机场在完成大规模扩建后，今年前九个月客流量超过6700万人次，重新成为中国最繁忙的机场。该机场成功超越了同期客流量为6658万人次的上海浦东国际机场。
items.whyImportant: 这一数据变化凸显了广州作为区域航空枢纽的竞争力提升及中国民航市场的复苏。

items.title: Is Beijing’s 2027 military milestone now a US readiness deadline over Taiwan?
items.summary: America’s push for 2027 combat readiness in the Indo-Pacific is raising questions over whether a year that US military officials linked to a possible People’s Liberation Army attack on Taiwan has instead become a planning benchmark. The preparations come despite a US intelligence assessment published in March that mainland Chinese leaders “do not currently plan” to attack Taiwan in 2027, “nor do they have a fixed timeline for achieving unification”. General Ronald Clark, commander of US Army...
items.titleZh: 北京的2027年军事里程碑是否已成为美国针对台湾的战备最后期限？
items.summaryZh: 美国在印太地区推进2027年战备目标，引发外界猜测该时间点是否已成为美军应对台海局势的规划基准。尽管美国情报评估显示目前并无明确的攻击时间表，但美军指挥官正加紧相关准备工作。
items.whyImportant: 这一规划基准的设定加剧了中美在台海问题上的战略博弈与紧张氛围。

items.title: Iran’s supreme leader warns US, Israel against war
items.summary: Iran’s supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei on Saturday warned the United States and Israel against returning to war, according to a written statement, following threats from the Islamic republic’s foes of a possible resumption of strikes. “If the enemies once again launch military or terrorist attacks, it is the armed forces of the Islamic Republic and the Iranian nation that will determine the time and conditions for ending them,” said a statement attributed to Khamenei posted on his website. The...
items.titleZh: 伊朗最高领袖警告美国和以色列不要发动战争
items.summaryZh: 伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊发表声明，警告美国和以色列不要采取军事或恐怖袭击。他强调，若遭到攻击，伊朗武装力量和人民将决定反击的时间与条件。
items.whyImportant: 此番强硬表态进一步加剧了中东地区本已紧张的军事对峙风险。

items.title: UK police should not have let US force take over airbase trial, MoD documents show
items.summary: According to documents obtained by the Guardian, officials accused Cambridgeshire force of breaching US-UK deal by handing over case of woman strangled by US pilot Ministry of Defence officials have privately accused a UK police force of wrongly handing over the investigation of an American fighter pilot who strangled a British woman to the US military, according to documents obtained by the Guardian. Cambridgeshire police allowed the US military police to quickly take control of the investigation into Capt Jacob Wulfson after he had been accused of sexually assaulting Sarah Steele in his Cambridge flat. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国国防部文件显示：警方不应允许美军接管空军基地案件调查
items.summaryZh: 据《卫报》获取的文件显示，英国国防部官员私下指责剑桥郡警方违规，将一名美军飞行员涉嫌勒死英国女性的案件移交给美军处理。警方在接到指控后，迅速允许美军宪兵接管了对雅各布·沃尔夫森上尉的调查。
items.whyImportant: 此事件引发了关于司法管辖权及美英军事协议执行情况的争议，受到公众广泛关注。

items.title: With ‘Kissinger moment’ over, US and China urged to foster new ‘bridge builders’
items.summary: Beijing and Washington have been urged to foster a new generation of talent to bridge gaps between the countries and strengthen people-to-people exchanges amid growing frictions and concerns about a lack of China expertise in the US. Academics and experts from the two countries gathered in Shanghai on Friday at the China-US Intergenerational Dialogue 2026. They were seeking a new crop of “bridge builders” like Henry Kissinger, the former US secretary of state who helped to engineer the historic...
items.titleZh: 随着“基辛格时刻”结束，美中被敦促培养新一代“桥梁建设者”
items.summaryZh: 面对双边摩擦加剧及美国国内中国专业人才匮乏的担忧，北京和华盛顿被敦促培养新一代人才以加强民间交流。在上海举行的中美代际对话会议上，专家们呼吁寻找像基辛格那样能够弥合两国分歧的“桥梁建设者”。
items.whyImportant: 在当前地缘政治紧张背景下，加强两国人才交流被视为缓解对抗、促进长期稳定的关键。

items.title: Starmer says UK must get closer to Europe as US relationship changes
items.summary: Shift in dealings with Washington not likely to reset once Trump leaves Oval Office, former PM says The UK and other European nations must draw closer together as the US becomes a less-reliable partner, Keir Starmer has said in his first significant political intervention since leaving No 10. The former prime minister warned European leaders of the threat posed by Russia, among others, and said the shift in relations with Washington during Donald Trump’s presidency was not likely to reset once he leaves the Oval Office. He accused them of being caught out by these new realities twice already. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 斯塔默称随着美英关系变化，英国必须与欧洲走得更近
items.summaryZh: 英国前首相斯塔默表示，随着美国日益成为不可靠的伙伴，英国及其他欧洲国家必须加强团结。他警告称，特朗普执政期间美英关系发生的转变即便在特朗普离任后也难以恢复原状。
items.whyImportant: 这一表态反映了欧洲政界对美国外交政策不确定性的深层忧虑，可能影响未来英国的战略重心。

items.title: More than 50m Americans cast ballots in early voting with three days to go before midterms
items.summary: Record number of early votes cast, with Democrats outnumbering Republicans in states which collect that information There has been a surge of early voting for the US midterm elections, with millions more Americans going to the polls compared with the last such election amid a series of tight contests that will determine control of Congress. More than 50.5m early votes have been cast across the US as of Saturday morning, according to an analysis by the University of Florida. This is already nearly 5m more votes than the total number of early votes made in the last midterm elections, in 2022. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 美国中期选举临近，提前投票人数已超5000万
items.summaryZh: 美国中期选举投票进入最后三天，提前投票人数创下历史新高。据佛罗里达大学分析，目前已有超过5050万张选票投出，比2022年中期选举的总提前投票数多出近500万。
items.whyImportant: 高投票率反映了选民对国会控制权争夺的高度关注，可能对选举最终结果产生重大影响。

items.title: Far from home, close to grief: why millions of Filipino migrants dread Undas
items.summary: For over three decades, Dolores Balladares Pelaez has lived and worked in Hong Kong without once returning to the Philippines for Undas, the annual two-day observance honouring the dead. This year, she is arranging prayers from afar for her late father and four siblings, but will once again miss the gathering back home. On Thursday morning, the 56-year-old domestic helper called her mother and niece in Laguna province to discuss hiring a prayer leader to visit the family home. Her sisters-in-law...
items.titleZh: 远离家乡，心系哀思：为何数百万菲律宾移民惧怕“亡人节”
items.summaryZh: 对于在香港工作的菲律宾家政工多洛雷斯·巴拉达雷斯·佩拉埃斯而言，由于长期无法回国，每年的“亡人节”都充满了对已故亲人的思念。她只能通过远程安排祈祷仪式，以表达对家乡亲人的哀思。
items.whyImportant: 该报道揭示了海外劳工群体在传统节日期间面临的心理压力与情感困境。

items.title: India’s largest dam planned to counter China faces Indigenous revolt
items.summary: Indigenous people of Arunachal Pradesh are protesting a mega dam planned to counter China's upstream hydropower project.
items.titleZh: 印度计划修建最大水坝以抗衡中国，引发原住民抗议
items.summaryZh: 印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦的原住民正在抗议一项大型水坝建设计划。该项目旨在抗衡中国在上游地区推进的水电工程。
items.whyImportant: 该项目涉及跨境水资源开发与当地原住民权益的冲突，是中印地缘政治竞争在边境地区的具体体现。

items.title: Quad not ‘anti-China’, says Rubio as first summit in two years set before Trump-Xi talks
items.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Saturday that the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, or the Quad, was not an “anti-China” coalition, as the grouping’s top diplomats finalised preparations for the leaders’ summit in the Philippines next month. Rubio’s statement comes just weeks before US President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping in Shenzhen, China. “It is not an anti-China or anti-anybody coalition,” Rubio said at a press conference on the sidelines of the...
items.titleZh: 卢比奥称“四方安全对话”并非“反华”联盟，峰会将在特朗普与习近平会晤前举行
items.summaryZh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，“四方安全对话”（Quad）并非针对中国的联盟。该组织正为下个月在菲律宾举行的领导人峰会做准备，而此前美国总统特朗普计划在深圳与中国领导人习近平会晤。
items.whyImportant: 此表态旨在缓和地区紧张局势，为即将到来的高层会晤营造外交氛围。
